question: Show the names and locations of stadiums used for concerts in 2014, listing each stadium once.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.Name, s.Location FROM stadium AS s JOIN concert AS c ON CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS VARCHAR) = c.Stadium_ID WHERE c.Year = '2014'
candidate_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.Name, s.Location
FROM stadium AS s
JOIN concert AS c
  ON TRY_CAST(c.Stadium_ID AS BIGINT) = s.Stadium_ID
WHERE c.Year = '2014';
